rationale: Lyc. plural ⲛ̄ⲧⲟⲩϣⲉⲩⲉ in cosmographic context 'their cisterns of the north' — locus where Adamas binds Hyle. Likely reflex of ϣⲏⲩ 'wells, cisterns' or ϣⲱⲩⲉ 'pits.' Cosmic-binding locus in the northern dark region.

ⲡⲉⲧ- ('the one who') + ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ('boast, glory, exalt oneself'). Substantival designation of the proud cosmic adversary — the dragon/abortion or related dark figure to whom Nature falls in the third molding. Manichaean cosmological epithet.
ⲍⲱⲙ (Lyc. = ϩⲱⲙ 'tread, walk') + ⲣⲉⲧ⸗ ('foot') = 'tread, set foot down.' Cosmological act of conquest: Adamas places his foot upon the defeated Hyle until the end of the cosmos.

Abstract ⲙⲛⲧ- + ⲁϣⲣⲉ (likely Lyc. for ϣⲉⲉⲣⲉ 'daughter, girl' or related youth/maidenhood term). The 'great teaching of Maidenhood' likely names the divine instruction associated with the Virgin of Light, given through Adamas. Tentative.

Verb in line 23 (ⲡⲛⲁⲃⲉ ⲉⲧⲁϩⲃⲁⲟϩ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ϩⲛ̄ ⲛⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ) of Sin-Hyle bursting forth from the archons. Cognate or parallel to ⲃⲉⲃⲉ 'gush' in Manichaean cosmogony of dark emanations. Tentative; awaits parallels.
